informacion_hub.title: Information Hub
informacion_hub.subtitle: Visual Merchandising standards, operating workflow and FAQs
informacion_hub.estandares_sub: Official mandatory guidelines for all retail stores nationwide
informacion_hub.regla_1_desc: Every exhibition with integrated LED fixtures must remain 100% turned on during store working hours.
informacion_hub.regla_2_desc: Sample casings must be free of dust, fingerprints, and grease. No visible dents, scratches, or deformations.
informacion_hub.regla_3_desc: Talkers, headers, and specs sheets must belong to the active campaign with current prices properly placed.
informacion_hub.regla_4_desc: Knobs, grates, burners, and accessories must be complete. Never display a product with missing parts.
informacion_hub.conforme_criterio_desc: The exhibition satisfies all complete, clean, lighted components with official POP without anomalies.
informacion_hub.no_conforme_criterio_desc: Missing component, burned/turned-off lights, damaged material, dirtiness or missing visible price.
informacion_hub.tipo_pared: Wall Module (Main backing for built-in line or free-standing cookers)
informacion_hub.tipo_isla: Central Island (360° high-traffic display in main aisle)
informacion_hub.tipo_cabecera: Gondola Endcap (Prominent spot at aisle entrance)
informacion_hub.tipo_podium: Podium / Platform (Individual display for premium launches)
informacion_hub.flujo_sub: Lifecycle of an exhibition on the retail floor
informacion_hub.paso_1_desc: When a new module is set up, register store, module type, casings, and full-body photo.
informacion_hub.paso_2_desc: On every store visit, the promoter or supervisor audits component by component to certify status.
informacion_hub.paso_3_desc: If a component is broken, POP is missing, or lighting fails, generate a ticket for Trade Marketing attention.
informacion_hub.comparativa_titulo: When to use Checklist vs when to open a Ticket?
informacion_hub.comparativa_checklist_item1: Conducted periodically during every store visit.
informacion_hub.comparativa_checklist_item2: Evaluates the overall state of the entire exhibition.
informacion_hub.comparativa_checklist_item3: Generates the compliance rate for executive analytics.
informacion_hub.comparativa_ticket_item1: Issued only when a specific physical problem is detected.
informacion_hub.comparativa_ticket_item2: Requests physical replacement of casings, knobs, cables or POP.
informacion_hub.comparativa_ticket_item3: Goes through approval workflow (Supervisor -> Trade -> Warehouse).
informacion_hub.faq_1_q: What do I do if a store moves the exhibition to another spot?
informacion_hub.faq_1_a: Open the exhibition details and update the 'Location' or 'Floor' field. If the relocation was major, take a new general photo.
informacion_hub.faq_2_q: How do I take photos if mobile signal is poor inside the store?
informacion_hub.faq_2_a: Take photos with your phone camera app. When you get to an area with better reception or Wi-Fi, open the app and pick them from gallery.
informacion_hub.faq_3_q: How long does Trade Marketing take to resolve a ticket?
informacion_hub.faq_3_a: Standard turnaround (SLA) is 48 to 72 hours for Metropolitan Lima and 3 to 5 business days for provinces, subject to stock.
informacion_hub.faq_4_q: What should I do if a store does not allow taking photos?
informacion_hub.faq_4_a: Contact your Trade Marketing zone supervisor immediately so they can coordinate authorization with the store manager.
informacion_hub.soporte_sub: Support channels for Sole Trade Marketing field promoters and supervisors
informacion_hub.soporte_horario: Operating Hours: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM / Saturdays 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM
